description_en: Retrieves the download link for failed files
name: GetFailFile

parameters.help_en:
The site ID. You can obtain the site ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation.
<notice>This parameter is required when you query failed files.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取。
<notice>查询失败文件时此参数为必填。></notice>
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The file upload task ID. You can obtain the task ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850466.html operation to create an upload task, or by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2851127.html operation to query existing tasks.
<notice>This parameter is required. If it is not provided, the operation returns InvalidParameters(400). If a non-existent task ID is specified, the operation returns InvalidTaskId.Malformed(400).></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
文件上传任务id。可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850466.html接口创建上传任务获取，或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2851127.html接口查询已有任务
<notice>此参数为必填，未提供时接口返回 InvalidParameters(400)；传入不存在的任务 ID 时接口返回 InvalidTaskId.Malformed(400)。></notice>
parameters.name: upload_id

DownloadLink.description_en: The download link for the files of the failed task
DownloadLink.description_zh: 失败任务文件下载链接
